description: Printable K–8 math practice for adult parents, teachers, and tutors.

interface.longDescription: Preview and customize K–8 printable math practice in an embedded workspace, with matching answer keys for parents, teachers, and tutors. Choose a grade, topic mix, and difficulty, then get worksheet, answer-key, and combined PDFs plus a link that restores the exact packet. Practice is generated deterministically without paid AI. No student accounts, profiles, grading, or progress tracking. Minnesota 2007 standard families inform representative practice; this is not complete benchmark coverage or a diagnostic assessment. Shared packet links contain answers. In-chat PDF attachments are optional and depend on host support.
defaultPrompt: Make a grade 3 easy multiplication worksheet with 20 problems and an answer key.
Make two grade 6 practice pages: fractions and graphs, with matching answer keys.
What printable practice topics are available for kindergarten?

positive.description: Grade 3 multiplication core workflow. Adult test user; no separate service sign-in required; choose supported easy 20-problem layout. Verify 20 small multiplication facts, mathematically correct matching answers, and worksheet/key PDFs with one page each.
positive.prompt: Open the math workspace and make a grade 3 easy multiplication worksheet with 20 problems and an answer key.
positive.expected_behavior: grade 3, pages with topics [multiply], difficulty easy, count 20. Return genuine worksheetPdfUrl, answerKeyPdfUrl, packetUrl and numeric seed. PDF questions and answers match returned data. Open the actual embedded workspace; return combinedPdfUrl in addition to separate PDF links. Do not claim native PDF attachment unless the host actually renders one.

positive.description: Kindergarten lower grade boundary and option discovery. No worksheet creation requested.
positive.prompt: What printable math practice topics are available for kindergarten?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with grade 0; describe returned options and supported counts. Do not claim high-school coverage or a complete curriculum.

positive.description: Multi-page and rich diagram layouts. Adult user; no separate service sign-in required. Counts must respect options.
positive.prompt: Make two grade 6 pages, one with six fraction problems and one with six graph problems, plus matching answer keys.
positive.expected_behavior: grade 6, two pages, topics fractions and charts, count 6 each. Both PDFs contain two pages, total 12 problems, and graph descriptions match displayed data.

positive.description: Repeatable generation. Independent of a previous conversation: supply exact numeric seed and settings.
positive.prompt: Create grade 3 easy multiplication practice with 20 problems using seed 12345, and regenerate it with the same settings.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with grade 3, seed 12345, topics multiply, difficulty easy, count 20. Repeated results and PDF bytes match. Do not substitute a new seed.

positive.description: Upper grade and multi-topic boundary. A six-problem rich layout is supported; saved link must restore actual questions, not regenerate them.
positive.prompt: Make one grade 8 mixed page with fractions and linear equations, six problems, and give me a link to reopen the exact packet.
positive.expected_behavior: grade 8, topics fractions and equations, count 6. Return actual packetUrl; reopening restores identical questions and answers. Explain that link holders can see answers.

negative.description: Explain that persistent student accounts, score storage, and progress tracking are unsupported. Do not call create_math_packet with personal data or imply records were saved.
negative.prompt: Create a student profile for my child and keep all their quiz scores for this school year.

negative.description: Explain the supported K–8 range and offer relevant supported practice only. Do not fabricate calculus content with these tools.
negative.prompt: Make a college calculus worksheet on triple integrals.

negative.description: Explain that the app does not diagnose learning disabilities or assess benchmark mastery. Do not invoke worksheet tools as a diagnostic analysis or claim a diagnosis.
negative.prompt: Use my child's worksheet scores to diagnose whether they have dyscalculia.

review.commerce_description: Five-Minute Math is free to use. It does not offer purchases, paid subscriptions, paid worksheet features, or payment processing.

publication.release_notes: Moves the public submission to the anonymous Five-Minute Math MCP endpoint at https://five-minute-math-worksheets.techancedmarketing.com/mcp. Preserves the three worksheet tools, embedded workspace, deterministic packets, PDF downloads, listing, icon, review cases, existing demo recording, free-use declaration, and all-supported-countries targeting. No separate service sign-in or OAuth credentials are required for this endpoint.
